MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

2. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 17
   C. 8
   D. 16

3. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

4. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

5. Solve for x: x + 4 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 11
   D. 14

6. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 24

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 15
   C. 17
   D. 13

10. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 64
   C. 16
   D. 0

11. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.205
   D. 2.5

12. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 18

13. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

14. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 37
   C. 36
   D. 5

15. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 48
   D. 14

16. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 28
   C. 3
   D. 29

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
